heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Using nginx as HTTP load balancer
supports: 可将同一应用的多个实例组成服务组，由入口按选定规则分配HTTP请求
NGINX未另配算法时使用轮询；轮询、最少连接和会话关联等方法各有取舍，不能推广为所有系统必须轮流分配
sources.sections: Introduction；Load balancing methods；Default load balancing configuration

verification.method: Actual full GET of the official NGINX fixed GitHub source, plus original-title, complete-sentence and claim-context review. Canonical reachability is recorded separately.

quotation.text: When the load balancing method is not specifically configured, it defaults to round-robin.

sources.title: HTTP Health Checks
supports: 主动检查向上游发送专门探测，检查失败时可暂停向该实例分配请求，通过要求的检查后恢复
fails与passes支持配置失败和恢复阈值；视频两次失败／两次成功是教学配置，不是默认或通用强制规则
NGINX开源版支持被动检查；本资料中主动探测功能属于NGINX Plus，不能将两者混同
sources.sections: Prerequisites；Passive Health Checks；Active Health Checks及health_check的interval／fails／passes参数

verification.method: Actual full GET of the official NGINX fixed GitHub source, plus original-title, complete-sentence and claim-context review. Canonical reachability is recorded separately.

quotation.text: The server is marked as unhealthy, and NGINX Plus does not send client requests to it until it once again passes a health check.

scope: One page, two original source titles and complete original sentences. Internal supports are claim mappings, not quotations.
